entities.summary: Alvise I Mocenigo was a political leaders in Venice (1507-11-05, Venice – 1577-06-14), a notable figure of the Early Modern era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Shaped political institutions and governance practices.
